title.zh: 用 LangChain 重写并对比

prompt.zh: 用 LangChain 的 `@tool` 定义同样的工具，比较它生成的模式与手写注册表的模式，再写一个适配器，使练习 3 的循环不加改动就能运行在 LangChain 的工具上。这个练习只需要 `langchain-core`，不需要模型。
prompt.en: Define the same tools with `@tool` of LangChain, compare the schema it generates with that of the hand-written registry, and write an adapter that lets the loop of exercise 3 run unchanged on LangChain tools. This exercise needs only `langchain-core` and no model.

hints.zh: 两种模式都是 `{'type': 'function', 'function': {...}}` 的结构，参数在 `['function']['parameters']` 下。
hints.en: Both schemas have the structure `{'type': 'function', 'function': {...}}`, with the parameters under `['function']['parameters']`.

hints.zh: LangChain 的工具用 `tool.invoke(arguments)` 执行，参数不合法时会抛出异常，需要捕获并转成以 `ERROR` 开头的文本。
hints.en: A LangChain tool is executed with `tool.invoke(arguments)`, which raises on invalid arguments. Catch the exception and turn it into text beginning with `ERROR`.
